title: Possible bug in Optimistic Locking feature in BaseActiveRecord?
body:
Hi,

I think there might be a bug in the Optimistic Locking feature in BaseActiveRecord.  It does not throw StaleObjectException despite following instructions in [the API document](http://www.yiiframework.com/doc-2.0/yii-db-baseactiverecord.html#optimisticLock%28%29-detail).  However, when I changed line 706 in BaseActiveRecord.php from:
`if (!isset($values[$lock])) {`
to:
`if (isset($values[$lock])) {`
it works.

Here are the steps I took to produce the problem:
## Before code change
1. Open 2 browsers, go to update screen for the same record in both browsers, update the same field (start_dt) in both browsers to different values but do not click 'Update'
2. Click 'Update' in browser 1.  Update successful.  Log entry below:

```
2014-11-29 17:01:32 [127.0.0.1][1][-][info][yii\db\Command::execute] UPDATE `a_user` SET `start_dt`='2014-11-11 00:00:00', `expiry_dt`=NULL, `update_dt`='2014-11-29 09:01:32', `update_no`=0 WHERE (`user_ky`=4) AND (`update_no`='0')
```
1. Click 'Update' in browser 2.  Update also successful (Should throw StaleObjectException).  Log entry below:

```
2014-11-29 17:02:18 [127.0.0.1][1][-][info][yii\db\Command::execute] UPDATE `a_user` SET `start_dt`='2014-11-12 00:00:00', `expiry_dt`=NULL, `update_dt`='2014-11-29 09:02:18', `update_no`=0 WHERE (`user_ky`=4) AND (`update_no`='0')
```
1. Retrieving the record also shows field updated to browser 2's value, which is wrong.
2. Also, from the logs above, the locking attribute (update_no) was not incremented.
## After changing line 706 in BaseActiveRecord.php to remove the '!' from (isset)
1. Open 2 browsers, go to update screen for the same record in both browsers, update the same field (start_dt) in both browsers to different values but do not click 'Update'
2. Click 'Update' in browser 1.  Update successful.  Log entry below:

```
2014-11-29 17:07:12 [127.0.0.1][1][-][info][yii\db\Command::execute] UPDATE `a_user` SET `start_dt`='2014-11-13 00:00:00', `expiry_dt`=NULL, `update_dt`='2014-11-29 09:07:12', `update_no`=1 WHERE (`user_ky`=4) AND (`update_no`='0')
```
1. Click 'Update' in browser 2.  Update correctly throws yii\db\StaleObjectException.  Log entry below:

```
2014-11-29 17:08:10 [127.0.0.1][1][-][info][yii\db\Command::execute] UPDATE `a_user` SET `start_dt`='2014-11-14 00:00:00', `expiry_dt`=NULL, `update_dt`='2014-11-29 09:08:10', `update_no`=1 WHERE (`user_ky`=4) AND (`update_no`='0')
    in D:\work\asm\asm\modules\asm\controllers\UserController.php:102
2014-11-29 17:08:10 [127.0.0.1][1][-][error][yii\db\StaleObjectException] exception 'yii\db\StaleObjectException' with message 'The object being updated is outdated.' in D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\db\BaseActiveRecord.php:716
Stack trace:
#0 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\db\ActiveRecord.php(545): yii\db\BaseActiveRecord->updateInternal(NULL)
#1 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\db\BaseActiveRecord.php(584): yii\db\ActiveRecord->update(true, NULL)
#2 D:\work\asm\asm\modules\asm\controllers\UserController.php(102): yii\db\BaseActiveRecord->save()
#3 [internal function]: app\modules\asm\controllers\UserController->actionUpdate('4')
#4 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\base\InlineAction.php(55): call_user_func_array(Array, Array)
#5 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\base\Controller.php(151): yii\base\InlineAction->runWithParams(Array)
#6 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\base\Module.php(455): yii\base\Controller->runAction('update', Array)
#7 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\web\Application.php(83): yii\base\Module->runAction('asm/user/update', Array)
#8 D:\work\asm\asm\vendor\yiisoft\yii2\base\Application.php(375): yii\web\Application->handleRequest(Object(yii\web\Request))
#9 D:\work\asm\asm\web\index.php(12): yii\base\Application->run()
#10 {main}
Additional Information:
Array
(
)
```
1. Also from the log entry above, update_no is incremented in the update statement.

Am I right, or is there something that I failed to implement when doing optimistic locking?  

Thanks in advance for your help,
Yu-Gin
